items.creator: NVIDIA

summaries.zh: NVIDIA 推出的 Auto Ontology 是一个 Python 框架，旨在为数据构建基于图的语义推理层。该工具支持确定性查询生成与优化上下文检索，能够显著提升大语言模型（LLM）及智能体工作流的可解释性。该项目目前在 GitHub 上已获得 4720 个 Star。
summaries.en: NVIDIA’s "Auto Ontology" is a Python framework designed to build semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It aims to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) and agent workflows by enabling deterministic query generation, improving context retrieval, and providing more explainable AI. The open-source project has garnered significant attention on GitHub, accumulating over 4,700 stars and 379 forks.
